# MobileFilmLab v0.1.0-alpha.9 — beta-roadmap test candidate

**ALPHA ONLY — not a beta.** Package `com.mobilefilmlab.camera`, versionCode `9`, same release signing certificate as earlier alphas. Install over alpha.8 to retain app data.

## Main changes

- **Oppo Natural (Camera2) is the default.** No added film grade or grain; default unedited 1× capture preserves the exposed original JPEG pixel data. Three Camera2 baselines plus all 77 original recipes remain. This is **not** proprietary Oppo/Hasselblad stock-app tuning or a measured calibration.
- **Native pixels by default.** Removed automatic enlargement and the misleading “super-resolution” claim. Optional resized export is labelled interpolation. Corrected double-cropping and physical-lens zoom multiplication.
- ISO-aware edge-adaptive luminance sharpening, bounded halos/row buffers and explicit Off/Fine/Medium/Coarse grain.
- **Experimental** 3-frame JPEG fusion with registration/exposure normalization/motion rejection; capability-gated OEM HDR/Night sessions and PRIVATE reprocessing ZSL, with visible fallback and timeouts. These are not verified stock-camera equivalents or guaranteed detail/latency improvements.
- Tap focus/metering; volume-key repeat suppression; sensor-driven horizon; toggleable thirds/golden/square guides; device-oriented JPEG capture; configurable haptics.
- Shared live colour matrix, recipe thumbnail previews, up to six starred quick-switch favourites and draggable before/after comparison. Final grain/sharpness/OEM processing can differ from preview.
- Versioned `.filmrecipe` JSON and QR PNG export, JSON/QR-image import with validation/limits/new custom IDs; custom deletion and persistent favourites.
- In-app swipe/zoom gallery, actual dimensions/EXIF/processing notes, Android share and confirmed deletion. No hardcoded 28.1MP/wide-camera info.
- Handler-confined camera lifecycle, timestamp-paired JPEG/results, accurate flash/EV/aperture/lens metadata, background processing/storage, partial-save cleanup, thermal safeguards and explicit errors instead of placeholder photos.
- Explicit alpha/stable update checks, no silent installation/analytics, automatic prerelease publishing and a separate beta-approval guard. F-Droid metadata starter only, no submission.

## Test this first

1. Compare **Natural + native pixels + grain Off + calibration 1.00** against the stock app on all exposed lenses, at matched viewing size.
2. Verify focus, flash, orientation, EXIF and 1×/2× framing. Hold the crop button for 1×/1.5×/2×/3×.
3. Test custom presets, file/QR exchange, gallery and lifecycle/50-shot stability.
4. Test experimental fusion/OEM/ZSL separately; copy the actual capability report. Firmware can block features even when code compiles.

Read the attached **ALPHA_9_TESTING.md** and [beta readiness gates](https://github.com/TheSwagInDisguise/MobileFilmLab/blob/main/docs/BETA_READINESS.md). **Handset quality, lens calibration, flash, extension support, ZSL timing and thermal/battery results are still pending.** No beta will be promoted without the owner's test feedback and explicit approval.

See [known limitations](https://github.com/TheSwagInDisguise/MobileFilmLab/blob/main/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md). Earlier precise claims about Oppo sensor/AI internals, lossless quality-100 JPEG, guaranteed native 28MP and recovered detail were not established and are corrected in this release/documentation.
